stem:
Aarav must cover a rectangular desk top that is $6$ units long and $4$ units wide with square tiles of side $1$ unit. He also has a square tray of side $5$ units.

Which two claims correctly use area in square units?

options.text: The desk needs $6+4=10$ square tiles, counting length and width as the covered region.
The desk area is $6\times4=24$ square units.
The square tray area is $5\times5=25$ square units.
Area is the distance around the desk edge, so the tray and desk share one perimeter rule for covering.

teacher.key_rationale: Area of a rectangle is length×width; area of a square is side×side. Sum of sides or perimeter is not area.
